# LibreOffice Calc GUI Interface Description

## Application Window

- **Title Bar**
  - Displays "invoices.xlsx - LibreOffice Calc"
  - Includes system control buttons: Minimize, Maximize/Restore, Close
  - Shows current date and time: "Oct 22 19:10"
  - System tray icons visible on the top-right

- **Menu Bar**
  - Contains standard menu options: File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Styles, Sheet, Data, Tools, Window, Help

- **Toolbar**
  - Contains a variety of icons for common actions:
    - File operations (New, Open, Save, Print)
    - Clipboard operations (Cut, Copy, Paste)
    - Formatting tools (Bold, Italic, Underline, Font color, Text alignment)
    - Cell formatting (Borders, Fill color, Number formatting)
    - Data operations (Sort, Filter, Find, Go To)
    - Chart and object insertion tools
    - Formula tools (Function wizard, Sum, Percentage, Currency formatting)
    - Drawing tools (Shapes, Lines, Arrows)
    - Special characters and symbols (Ω, etc.)
    - Linking and commenting tools

- **Formula Bar**
  - Displays the current cell reference: "G2"
  - Shows the current cell's content: "1467.32"
  - Contains formula input area with operators: f., Σ, =
  - Shows the current font: "Calibri", size: "11 pt"

## Notification Banner

- **Blue Banner**
  - Contains two informational messages:
    - "Help us make LibreOffice even better!"
    - "Your donations support our worldwide community."
  - Includes two buttons:
    - "Get involved" (on the right)
    - "Donate" (on the right)
  - Each message has a blue circular information icon to its left

## Worksheet Area

- **Grid Layout**
  - Grid of cells organized in rows and columns
  - Row numbers on the left (1 to 36 visible)
  - Column letters at the top (A to Q visible)

- **Header Row (Row 1)**
  - Contains column headers:
    - A: Invoice Number
    - B: Date
    - C: Client Name
    - D: Item Description
    - E: Quantity
    - F: Unit Price
    - G: Total
    - H: Payment Status
  - Column G ("Total") is highlighted with a red background

- **Data Rows (Rows 2 to 11)**
  - Each row contains invoice data:
    - Row 2: INV-2023-001, 2023-11-14, Acme Corp, Graphic Design, 4, 366.83, 1467.32, Paid
    - Row 3: INV-2023-002, 2023-11-07, Acme Corp, Marketing Strategy, 3, 60.43, 181.29, Pending
    - Row 4: INV-2023-003, 2023-02-15, Gamma Solutions, Graphic Design, 1, 114.5, 114.5, Paid
    - Row 5: INV-2023-004, 2023-12-25, Acme Corp, Consulting Services, 9, 402.02, 3618.18, Pending
    - Row 6: INV-2023-005, 2023-08-29, Epsilon LLC, Software Development, 3, 360.93, 1082.79, Overdue
    - Row 7: INV-2023-006, 2023-09-05, Epsilon LLC, Consulting Services, 6, 460.47, 2762.82, Paid
    - Row 8: INV-2023-007, 2023-04-25, Acme Corp, Consulting Services, 1, 245.23, 245.23, Pending
    - Row 9: INV-2023-008, 2023-05-14, Epsilon LLC, Software Development, 2, 87.35, 174.7, Overdue
    - Row 10: INV-2023-009, 20
